name: Diabellstar the Black Witch
ability: You can Special Summon this card (from your hand) by sending 1 card from your hand or field to the GY. You can only Special Summon "Diabellstar the Black Witch" once per turn this way. During your opponent's turn, if this card is sent from its owner's hand or field to the GY: You can send 1 card from your hand or field to the GY, and if you do, Special Summon this card.

ability: If you Ritual Summon exactly 1 LIGHT Ritual Monster (Warrior or Dragon) with a card effect that requires use of monsters, this card can be used as the entire Tribute. name: Phantom of Yubel
ability:
1 "Yubel" monster + 1 Fiend monster with 0 ATK/DEF

You can only use this effect of "Phantom of Yubel" once per turn.

name: Chicken Game
ability:

● Draw 1 card.
● Destroy this card.
● Your opponent gains 1000 LP.
Neither player can activate cards or effects in response to this effect's activation.
